contributions.detail: 147 Form A rows over pp2-8 sum to 34,227.25, which is 2,065.00 MORE than the printed anchor of 32,162.25. The difference is the FILER'S OWN page-subtotal arithmetic and is traced exactly: the seven printed page subtotals (5,880.00 + 3,056.00 + 4,146.25 + 3,825.00 + 4,450.00 + 7,955.00 + 2,850.00) sum to 32,162.25, i.e. the grand total is the sum of the filer's subtotals, not of the filer's rows. Two subtotals under-count their own sheets. (i) p6 'Subtotal page 5 of 7' prints 4,450.00 against 25 rows that sum to 4,750.00 - short by exactly one 300.00 row; all three 300.00 cells on that sheet (rows 1, 15, 23) were re-cropped at 900dpi and each verifiably reads 300.00, and the printed subtotal cell itself verifiably reads 4,450.00, so which of the three the filer's SUM range dropped cannot be determined FROM THE PAGE - the most likely reading, by analogy with the p7 defect below, is that the SUM range began at row 2 and omitted row 1 (Mary Evans, 300.00). (ii) p7 'Subtotal page 6 of 7' prints 7,955.00 against 26 rows that sum to 9,720.00 - short by exactly 1,765.00, which is the sum of that sheet's FIRST THIRTEEN rows (Sharon Lewis 100.00 through Yaeko Bryner 100.00); rows 14-26 alone sum to 7,955.00 exactly. Those first 13 rows are the ones typed with the figure inline as '$100.00' in a single cell instead of in the split '$ | amount' cells used by rows 14-26, so the filer's SUM range plainly started at row 14. Nothing was nudged: every row is the printed figure and the delta is left standing as the filer's arithmetic. IN-KIND CONVENTION: monetary-plus-in-kind is what the filer used - the single in-kind row (Rich & Kathy Peterson, 90.00, p6 row 16) is inside the p6 subtotal formula, since the p6 shortfall is exactly 300.00 and not 90.00, 210.00 or 390.00; excluding in-kind would move the p6 rows to 4,660.00 and close nothing.

expenditures.detail: 35 Form B rows sum to 32,769.16 exactly. Page gate: p9's printed 'Subtotal page 1 of 2' is 13,729.55 and its 23 rows sum to 13,729.55 exactly; p10 prints NO subtotal (its 12 rows sum to 19,039.61), and 13,729.55 + 19,039.61 = 32,769.16 = the printed grand total = both cover cells. No in-kind rows appear on Form B, so the two in-kind conventions are identical on this side.

notes: 11-page filing: p1 cover (unsigned photocopy), pp2-8 Form A 'Itemized Report of Contributions' over 7 sheets self-numbered 'Subtotal page N of 7', pp9-10 Form B 'Itemized Report of Expenditures' over 2 sheets, p11 a PHOTOGRAPH (taken on a wooden desk) of the SAME cover page - and that photographed copy IS SIGNED AND DATED: candidate signature 'Caitlin K. Gochnour' dated '6.16.16' and committee-secretary signature 'Elaine Feeny' dated '6/16/16', with identical figures. This corrects, at the document, the 2026-08-01 cover-cache note for this key, which records the form as 'UNSIGNED and UNDATED' - true of p1, false of p11. No report-type box is checked on either copy, so the report type remains an honest blank. 2016 3-line form variant: one 'Total contributions from all donors' line, so there is no >$50 / <=$50 split and the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply; Form A itemizes every donor including sub-$50 ones (25.00 and 20.00 rows appear). Donor and vendor street addresses printed on the forms are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY: city/state only). Form A's address column changes shape across sheets - pp2-4 print one combined 'street, City, ST zip' cell, pp5-7 print separate City / State / ZIP columns, and p8 reverts to a combined cell in which the filer often omitted the state; those omissions are recorded as blank state with a per-row note (left empty by the filer, NOT redacted by the county). One donor row (p7 row 18) is the filer's own 'Anonymous' entry with no address at all, 40.00 - kept as one row exactly as reported. Page 10 of the PDF prints a wholly blank table row above its first entry, which is why that frame trims four leading rules instead of three.
